title: Men's MMA – Undefeated. (Never Fought.) Hoodie

seo.title: MMA Hoodie – Undefeated. (Never Fought.)
seo.description: A funny MMA hoodie for armchair fighters: UNDEFEATED. (NEVER FOUGHT.) Gildan pullover, 8 oz fleece, Sand or Navy.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

UNDEFEATED. (NEVER FOUGHT.) is the MMA hoodie for the fight fan whose record is spotless because he has only ever fought from the couch, worn on fight night, at the gym and as a gift from friends who watch every card with him.

UNDEFEATED. runs across the top in tall condensed capitals and (NEVER FOUGHT.) fills the bottom, even wider. Between them a smug cartoon man in fight shorts, taped hands and a towel over his shoulder sits back in a recliner with a bowl of popcorn on his lap, a pair of unused boxing gloves hanging from the chair arm.

Navy carries cream and mustard lettering with a cream edge around the recliner; Sand gets navy and deep red lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this MMA hoodie warm enough for fight nights and cool gym mornings?
Yes. The Undefeated. (Never Fought.) hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for fight nights on the couch, cool gym mornings and walks home from training.

How does the Undefeated. (Never Fought.) hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for an MMA fan?
It is a natural one. Every fight fan has an opinion on every card without ever stepping on a mat, so it lands with armchair fighters, gym friends and the group chat on fight night. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the recliner scene sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Undefeated. (Never Fought.) hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
